channel.title: Edebo Blog
channel.description: Guides on 3D facial and body imaging, before-and-after measurement, patient consent and clinic growth for dermatologists, plastic surgeons and aesthetic clinics in India.

item.title: What Is 3D Facial Imaging? A Guide for Aesthetic Clinics
item.description: What 3D facial imaging is, how it differs from photos, what it measures and how Indian dermatology and aesthetic clinics use it in daily practice.

item.title: How Smartphone 3D Scanning Works: Photogrammetry Explained
item.description: A plain-language explanation of how a smartphone turns video frames into a measurable 3D model of the face or body, and what affects scan quality.

item.title: 2D vs 3D Imaging in Aesthetic Clinics: What Each Can Show
item.description: A side-by-side comparison of 2D clinical photography and 3D imaging for aesthetic consultations, follow-ups and records, with guidance on when each fits.

item.title: How Accurate Is Smartphone 3D Face Scanning? What Studies Show
item.description: A clear summary of published studies comparing smartphone 3D face scans with clinical systems like Vectra and 3dMD, and what it means for clinics.

item.title: 3D Imaging Rig vs Smartphone: Choosing a System for Your Clinic
item.description: Compare fixed 3D camera rigs, handheld scanners and smartphone-based 3D imaging on cost, accuracy, workflow and data handling, with a checklist for clinics.

item.title: Cost of 3D Imaging for Clinics in India: Rigs vs Subscriptions
item.description: What 3D imaging really costs an Indian clinic over five years: capital rigs vs phone-based subscriptions, hidden costs and how to model payback.

item.title: Lighting and Capture Tips for Better 3D Face and Body Scans
item.description: Practical tips to get clean, repeatable 3D scans in a clinic: lighting, patient positioning, phone movement, hair, makeup and a pre-scan checklist for staff.

item.title: 3D Imaging Glossary for Aesthetic Medicine: 40 Terms Explained
item.description: Plain-language definitions of the 3D imaging terms clinicians meet when evaluating scanning systems, from photogrammetry and point clouds to RMS and Bland-Altman.

item.title: Standardised Before and After Photos: A Protocol for Clinics
item.description: A step-by-step protocol for consistent before-and-after clinical photos in aesthetic and dermatology clinics: views, distance, lighting, pose, consent and storage.

item.title: Why 2D Before and After Photos Mislead Patients and Doctors
item.description: Camera distance, lens, lighting, head tilt and expression can all fake or hide aesthetic results in 2D photos. Here is how each distortion works and how to avoid it.

item.title: Measuring Aesthetic Results in Millimetres, Not Opinions
item.description: How 3D measurement turns aesthetic outcomes into numbers: volume, projection, symmetry and contour change between visits, and how to present them to patients.

item.title: Clinical Photography Setup for a Small Clinic on a Budget
item.description: How a small dermatology or aesthetic clinic in India can set up consistent clinical photography and 3D capture in one room without expensive equipment.

item.title: Tracking Patient Progress Across Follow-Up Visits in Aesthetics
item.description: A practical system for tracking aesthetic patients across follow-ups: baseline scans, review intervals, measured comparison and smart reminders.

item.title: Dermal Filler Volume Measurement With 3D Imaging
item.description: How clinicians use 3D imaging to plan and measure dermal filler results: baseline scans, volume colour maps, settling over time and patient talk.

item.title: Lip Filler Assessment and Planning With 3D Imaging
item.description: How 3D imaging helps clinicians assess lip proportions, symmetry and projection before lip filler, and show patients a measured, natural-looking result.

item.title: Under-Eye and Tear Trough Assessment With 3D Imaging
item.description: Why the tear trough is hard to judge in photos, and how 3D imaging helps assess hollowing, plan under-eye treatment and document subtle results.

item.title: Facial Symmetry Analysis With 3D Imaging: A Clinician's Guide
item.description: How 3D imaging measures facial asymmetry by mirroring and comparing the two halves of the face, and why documenting baseline asymmetry protects patients and clinics.

item.title: Hair Transplant Hairline Planning With 3D Imaging
item.description: How 3D imaging helps hair restoration clinics record the hairline, plan graft zones, document consent and show patients measured progress after a transplant.

item.title: Tracking Hair Restoration Progress Patients Can Actually See
item.description: How hair clinics can document hairline and scalp change across medical, procedural and surgical hair programmes, and keep patients engaged through slow early months.

item.title: Rhinoplasty Consultations With 3D Imaging: Plan and Explain
item.description: How plastic surgeons use 3D imaging in rhinoplasty and non-surgical nose consultations to analyse the profile, document asymmetry and align expectations.

item.title: Body Contouring Results: Measuring Change With 3D Imaging
item.description: How clinics can measure body contouring results, from non-surgical fat reduction to liposuction, with 3D scans instead of tape measures and inconsistent photos.

item.title: Breast Surgery Consultations With 3D Imaging: A Surgeon's Guide
item.description: How plastic surgeons use 3D imaging in breast augmentation, reduction and reconstruction consultations to document asymmetry, discuss volume and record outcomes.

item.title: Jawline and Chin Contouring: Planning and Proof With 3D Imaging
item.description: How 3D imaging helps clinicians assess chin projection and jawline definition, plan filler or surgical contouring and show measured results in profile.

item.title: Acne Scar Treatment: How to Track Progress Across Sessions
item.description: A practical guide for dermatologists on documenting acne scar treatment across multiple sessions with standardised imaging, texture scores and 3D surface records.

item.title: Tracking Pigmentation and Melasma Treatment Progress
item.description: How dermatologists can document pigmentation and melasma treatment consistently, with standardised capture, skin analysis scores and honest progress conversations.

item.title: In-Clinic Skin Analysis Explained: What It Measures and Why
item.description: What in-clinic skin analysis measures (pigmentation, redness, texture and pores), how it works, its limits, and how dermatology clinics use it to track treatment.

item.title: Documenting Botulinum Toxin Results: Static and Dynamic Views
item.description: How clinics can document neuromodulator treatment consistently: baseline and review timing, animation views, brow position and 3D records for lower-face slimming.

item.title: How to Increase Consultation Conversion in an Aesthetic Clinic
item.description: A practical system to convert more aesthetic consultations into treatment plans: structure, visual explanation, clear pricing and monthly KPIs.

item.title: Aesthetic Clinic Patient Retention: Why Patients Leave and Return
item.description: Why aesthetic and dermatology patients drop out of programmes or switch clinics, and a retention system built on measured progress, follow-up and trust.

item.title: Managing Patient Expectations in Aesthetic Consultations
item.description: How aesthetic clinicians can set realistic expectations, handle reference photos and filters, document agreed goals and reduce dissatisfaction after treatment.
